sections.text:
Ability Power 260. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical wind damage at success of 100 points.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases ATK/MATK of all allies by 60% for 60 seconds.
-Increases the physical and magic Ability Power for of all allies by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies by 20% for 60 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 2 for 40 seconds.
-Casts elevation on your character for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies by 10% for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases Unison gauge gains for all allies by 1 for 40 seconds.
